import json
files = {
  'bf16_ds_rand_s015': '/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/profiling_output_bf16_ds_rand_s015/profiling_results.json',
  'bf16_ds_rand_s020': '/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/profiling_output_bf16_ds_rand_s020/profiling_results.json',
  'bf16_ds_rand_s025': '/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/profiling_output_bf16_ds_rand_s025/profiling_results.json',
  'bf16_imp_s020': '/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/profiling_output_bf16_ds_imp_s020/profiling_results.json',
  'bf16_imp_s030': '/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/profiling_output_bf16_ds_imp_s030/profiling_results.json',
}
import statistics
for name, path in files.items():
    d = json.load(open(path))
    diag = d['diagnostics']
    # Check if per_problem_ii_stats exists as a key
    print(f'=== {name} ===')
    print('Keys in diagnostics:', list(diag.keys()))
    # Compute per-problem stats from raw data
    pp = diag.get('per_problem_ii', diag.get('per_problem_ii_stats', []))
    if not pp:
        pp = [p for p in diag.get('per_problem_sparsity', []) if 'ii_high' in (p if isinstance(p, dict) else {})]
        if not pp:
            # Try the other structure
            for k in diag:
                if 'ii' in k.lower():
                    print(f'  Found key: {k}')
    # Get ii values per phase
    highs = [p['ii_high'] for p in pp if p.get('ii_high') is not None]
    mids = [p['ii_mid'] for p in pp if p.get('ii_mid') is not None]
    lows = [p['ii_low'] for p in pp if p.get('ii_low') is not None]
    print(f'  high: n={len(highs)}, min={min(highs):.4f}, max={max(highs):.4f}, mean={statistics.mean(highs):.4f}, median={statistics.median(highs):.4f}, std={statistics.stdev(highs):.4f}')
    print(f'  mid:  n={len(mids)}, min={min(mids):.4f}, max={max(mids):.4f}, mean={statistics.mean(mids):.4f}, median={statistics.median(mids):.4f}, std={statistics.stdev(mids):.4f}')
    print(f'  low:  n={len(lows)}, min={min(lows):.4f}, max={max(lows):.4f}, mean={statistics.mean(lows):.4f}, median={statistics.median(lows):.4f}, std={statistics.stdev(lows):.4f}')
    # Gradient
    med_low = statistics.median(lows)
    med_high = statistics.median(highs)
    grad = med_low / med_high if med_high != 0 else float('inf')
    print(f'  gradient(low_median/high_median) = {grad:.4f}')
"
